rules.guidance: Use the open record for a bounded accepted request. Close only with actual resolution and verification evidence. Release, adoption, and consumer confirmation are required when the accepted outcome depends on them; use the literal value none only when a category does not apply. Tracker state, labels, priority, assignment, and prose truth remain consumer-owned.
